name: delegation
description: Delegation machinery: /delegate routes a task shape to the right specialist from the HOST's own agent roster (live model lookup, no hardcoded table), /create-new-sub-agent mints the specialist when none fits — template + linter included — and /improve runs an idea, plan, PR or file through domain lenses in parallel and returns an improved version. lenses.md is the shared domain registry. Also ships a PreToolUse hook that denies the general-purpose subagent and points at /delegate. Ships the router, the guard and the rule for making agents, never the agents.
